item.title: When Effie Met Effie: Watch Jennifer Hudson & Jenifer Lewis Perform a ‘Dreamgirls’ Duet
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trends and exciting moments in the entertainment world. Today, we're talking about a special performance that's got everyone buzzing. Jennifer Hudson and Jenifer Lewis came together to sing a powerful duet of "I Am Changing" from Dreamgirls.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Before they took the stage, Jenifer Lewis shared a fascinating story about her connection to the iconic musical. She revealed that she replaced Tony Award-winner Jennifer Holliday in the workshop production of Dreamgirls before it transferred to Broadway. Lewis even joked that she developed the role of Effie, while Holliday took it to Broadway, and Hudson brought it to the big screen.
[Clip of Jennifer Hudson and Jenifer Lewis singing plays briefly]
Host: The two powerhouses decided to sing "I Am Changing" together, a song that Lewis hadn't performed since she was 19 years old. The result was an epic duet that left the audience in awe. With their voices blending together in perfect harmony, Hudson and Lewis brought the house down.
[Clip of Jennifer Hudson and Jenifer Lewis singing plays briefly again]
Host: The performance ended with a heartfelt hug and exchanges of "I love you" between the two singers. Hudson was clearly thrilled, exclaiming, "I got to sing with Jenifer Lewis, yo! I'm living a dream right now."
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's podcast. If you want to see the full performance of Jennifer Hudson and Jenifer Lewis singing "I Am Changing," be sure to check out the clip from The Jennifer Hudson Show. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!
